faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. A reset link is sent to your registered email and expires after 30 minutes.

faqs.question: I lost access to my wallet / account, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Account recovery requires manual identity verification by our security team. Please do not share your seed phrase with anyone, including support staff. A specialist will contact you within 24-48 hours.

faqs.question: Why was my IDO allocation charge declined?
faqs.answer: Allocation charges can fail due to insufficient gas, network congestion, or KYC not being finalized. Check your KYC status in your GemLaunch dashboard before retrying.

faqs.question: My swap or staking transaction is stuck pending.
faqs.answer: Pending transactions are usually a network gas/congestion issue. Check the transaction hash on the relevant block explorer. If it has been pending over 2 hours, contact DeFi Support with the tx hash.

faqs.question: I want a refund for an NFT purchase on Blokkplay.
faqs.answer: NFT purchases are final on-chain and not automatically refundable. Refund requests are reviewed case-by-case by Gaming Support for verified minting errors or duplicate charges.

faqs.question: How do I apply to the Web3Geeks incubator?
faqs.answer: Submit a project application through the incubator page including your team, product, and traction. Our team reviews applications on a rolling basis.

faqs.question: My match result or reward wasn't recorded.
faqs.answer: Match results sync on-chain within 15 minutes. If a reward is still missing after that, contact Gaming Support with your match ID.

faqs.question: How do I dispute a billing charge?
faqs.answer: Billing disputes require a human review to verify transaction records before any adjustment or reversal is issued. This cannot be resolved automatically.
